common.noProbability: Calculated deterministically from the plan and the working calendar — no probability is estimated.
common.title: Title

plan.subtitle: WBS, timeline, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, baselines, look-ahead, what-if and health — all from the same plan data.

wbs.title: Work breakdown structure
wbs.empty: No activities in this plan yet.
wbs.draftHint: Draft activities are proposed by the template and are not yet confirmed into the plan. Confirming them does not invent dates or owners.
wbs.activateAllEffect: Draft activities in this workstream ({count}) become Not started and part of the confirmed plan.
wbs.activateAllScope: Durations, dates and owners are not changed; activities already confirmed are not affected.
wbs.progressLegend: Progress shows reported / evidence-verified. Only acceptance by someone other than the submitter counts as verified.

task.durationHint: Leave empty when to be determined — the schedule then reports it as a gap.
task.requiresAcceptanceHint: completion must be accepted, with evidence, by someone other than the submitter
task.progressHint: Reported progress is the owner's claim. Evidence-verified progress comes only from acceptance.
task.progressRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
task.draftNotice: This activity is still Draft (proposed by the template). Confirm it into the plan before work starts.
task.whatIfLink: Analyse a delay of this activity

milestone.evidenceHint: Achievement is verified only with at least one active evidence link, by someone other than the person who reported it.

deliverable.weightHint: Only approved weights count toward progress; a changed weight must be approved again, by someone other than the person who set it.
deliverable.approveWeightsEffect: The weights of the deliverables listed on this page ({count}) become approved and start counting toward weighted progress.
deliverable.weightResets: Changing the weight withdraws its approval.

owner.title: Accountable owner — {code}
owner.first: This record has no accountable owner yet.
owner.replaces: The current owner, {user}, will be replaced (requires the reassignment permission).
owner.memberRule: Only active members of this project can be owners. Each record has exactly one accountable owner.

raci.title: RACI
raci.hint: One accountable owner (A); additional Responsible, Consulted and Informed people or functions.
raci.removeEffect: {who} is removed from this record's RACI.
raci.functionHint: Use a function when the person is still to be confirmed.
raci.accountableRule: Accountability (A) is set with the accountable-owner action — never as a RACI entry.

dependency.typeHint: Only finish-to-start (FS) is supported; other types are refused until each is tested.
dependency.rules: The server rejects cycles, links to other projects and unsupported types. Lag is counted in working days on the project calendar.

schedule.targetHint: Choose an activity to see only the network that drives it (its transitive predecessors).
schedule.incompleteHint: No critical path is reported until these gaps are fixed ({count}):
schedule.issue_cycle: is part of a dependency cycle
schedule.issue_missing_project_start: The project has no planned start date
schedule.plannedOnly: Because the schedule is incomplete, the timeline shows planned dates only — not a calculated forecast.

gantt.caption: Timeline
gantt.empty: No activities with dates in this scope.
gantt.varianceLate: {days} calendar days later than the baseline finish
gantt.varianceEarly: {days} calendar days earlier than the baseline finish
gantt.varianceLegend: Variance against the baseline finish (calendar days)

baseline.hint: A baseline freezes start, finish, duration, deliverable weights, budget lines and the perimeter scope. After the first approval, a re-baseline needs an approved change request.
baseline.proposeEffect: The current confirmed plan is frozen as a new proposed baseline (with a snapshot hash).
baseline.proposeApproval: It becomes the approved baseline only when someone other than you approves it.
baseline.approveEffect: Baseline v{version} becomes the approved baseline; the previous approved baseline is kept as superseded.
baseline.approveWeights: Unchanged deliverable weights in the snapshot become approved.
baseline.rejectEffect: The proposal is rejected and stays on record.
baseline.rebaselineHint: Only approved change requests flagged for re-baselining and not yet used are listed.
baseline.noApprovedCr: No approved re-baselining change request available
baseline.frozenHint: The snapshot and its hash cannot be changed after proposal.
baseline.budgetRestricted: Budget lines: {count} (restricted — not shown with your access)
baseline.noTasks: No confirmed tasks in this baseline.
baseline.selfNotice: You proposed this baseline, so someone else must approve or reject it.
baseline.raisePaper: Raise decision paper for this baseline
baseline.approveAmount: The amount compared with the delegated limit is the total of the approved budget lines frozen in the snapshot.

whatIf.hint: What if an activity slips? The impact is calculated on the plan and the project calendar; nothing in the plan changes.
whatIf.targetHint: Optional: a milestone whose driving network is analysed.
whatIf.incomplete: The impact cannot be calculated while the schedule has gaps ({count}). Fix the gaps in the timeline first.

health.progressHint: Approved deliverable weights; only accepted deliverables count as done.
health.basis: {num} of {den} approved weight points accepted, across {count} deliverables.
health.worstOf: Worst of the workstreams and critical milestones — a green average never hides a red item.
health.thresholds: Proposed thresholds: green up to {green} working days of slip, amber up to {amber}, updates stale after {stale} days.
health.noBaseline: No approved baseline — variance cannot be measured yet.
health.dataQualityHint: Unknown, not updated and stale never count as green.
health.ruleHint: Open blockers make the status red; missing or old updates are never green.
health.asOf: Calculated on {date} ({tz}). Published report snapshots are not recalculated.

override.title: Manual status overrides
override.hint: An override needs a reason, an expiry date and review by someone other than the requester. The calculated status is always kept.
override.rules: Overrides expire automatically (at most 90 days) and never hide an open blocker from the project status.
override.expiresHint: After this date the calculated status applies again.
override.approveEffect: The effective status becomes {status} until {date}; the calculated status stays visible.
override.rejectEffect: The calculated status continues to apply.

update.title: Periodic updates
update.hint: Updates are submitted, reviewed by someone else and accepted; accepted updates are frozen as historical reporting versions.
update.ragHint: Your judgement — shown beside the calculated status, never instead of it.
update.ragCompare: The calculated status is recorded at submission and frozen at acceptance.
update.frozenNotice: This update was accepted and is frozen. Later plan changes do not alter it.

raid.subtitle: Risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies with owners, exposure and escalation — and change requests with impact assessment and approval.
raid.blockingRule: Open issues of severity 4–5 count as blockers and make the workstream red.
raid.raiseIssueEffect: An issue is created from {code} (the risk has materialised); the risk stays open until its owner closes it.
raid.heatAxes: Rows: probability (5 = very high). Columns: impact.

cr.empty: No change requests match the filters.
cr.hint: Draft → submitted → under review (impact assessment) → approved or rejected by someone other than the requester → implemented. A re-baselining change is implemented with a new approved baseline.
cr.impactsHint: Time, cost, scope, readiness, transaction, financial and TSA impacts. Approval requires at least one recorded impact.
cr.noImpacts: No impact recorded yet — the request cannot be approved.
cr.rebaselineHint: implementation needs a new approved baseline linked to this request
cr.rebaselineNext: Approved: propose the new baseline linked to this change request, then mark it implemented.
cr.subject: Subject
cr.assessHint: Describe each impact in plain language; leave a field empty when it does not apply.
cr.selfNotice: You requested this change, so someone else must approve or reject it.
cr.raisePaper: Raise decision paper for this change
cr.costImpactHint: Record the budget impact as an amount with currency and unit; enter 0 when the change has no cost impact. Approval compares it with the delegated limit.
cr.costTextOnly: A cost impact is described in text but has no amount: approval will be refused until you record it as money (0 when none).
cr.costNotQuantified: Described in text only — not quantified
cr.costUnconfirmed: Stated by the requester — an assessor other than the requester must record or confirm it before it can decide an approval.
cr.costConfirmed: Recorded by an assessor other than the requester.
cr.costBeforeApproval: Before approval, the assessor records the budget effect as an amount with currency and unit (0 when none) in the change request's impact assessment; a cost stated in text only is refused.

commands.evidenceRule: At least one active evidence link is required and no conflicting evidence may be open.
commands.notSelf: Separation of duties: the person who requested or submitted it cannot approve it.

task.activateEffect: The Draft activity becomes Not started and part of the confirmed plan.
task.startEffect: The task becomes In progress with the actual start date below.
task.blockEffect: The task becomes Blocked; its workstream shows red until the blocker is cleared.
task.unblockEffect: The task returns to In progress.
task.submitEffect: Reported complete; the approver is notified. Verified progress changes only when someone else accepts it.
task.acceptEffect: The task becomes Accepted and counts as evidence-verified complete.
task.rejectEffect: The task goes back to In progress with your reason.
task.completeEffect: Only for tasks that do not require acceptance: the task becomes Done (reported, not evidence-verified).
task.cancelEffect: The task is excluded from progress — it never counts as complete.
task.reopenEffect: The task returns to In progress; any previous acceptance is withdrawn.

milestone.reportEffect: The milestone is reported achieved and waits for evidence verification.
milestone.rejectEvidenceEffect: The milestone goes back to At risk; verification is withdrawn.
milestone.flagEffect: The milestone is marked At risk with your reason.
milestone.missedEffect: The milestone is marked Missed; a critical one turns the project red.
milestone.cancelEffect: The milestone is cancelled and excluded.

deliverable.submitEffect: The deliverable is submitted; the approver is notified.
deliverable.acceptEffect: The deliverable becomes Accepted and its approved weight counts toward progress.
deliverable.rejectEffect: The deliverable is rejected with your reason and can be resubmitted.
deliverable.cancelEffect: Excluded from the progress denominator — never counted as complete.
deliverable.reopenEffect: The deliverable returns to In progress; any acceptance is withdrawn.

raid.monitorEffect: The item is monitored until its trigger is reached.
raid.escalateEffect: The escalation level rises above the current level ({level}); the highest level is 3.
raid.mitigateEffect: The response is in place; the residual exposure is accepted.
raid.closeEffect: The item is closed with your reason.
raid.cancelEffect: The item is cancelled (recorded in error or no longer applicable).
raid.reopenEffect: The item is reopened with your reason.

cr.submitEffect: The change request is submitted for impact review.
cr.startReviewEffect: The request moves to Under review; impacts can then be assessed.
cr.approveEffect: The change request is approved. A re-baselining change still needs a new approved baseline.
cr.rejectEffect: The change request is rejected with your reason.
cr.withdrawEffect: The change request is withdrawn and stays on record.
cr.implementEffect: The approved change is recorded as implemented.
cr.implementRebaseline: Allowed only once a baseline linked to this request has been approved.
cr.approveCost: Budget impact compared with the delegated limit: {amount}.
cr.approveCostUnquantified: The cost impact is stated in text only: the server refuses the approval until it is recorded as an amount.

update.submitEffect: The update is submitted; the calculated status is recorded beside your reported status.
update.acceptEffect: The update and its metrics are frozen as a historical reporting version.
update.returnEffect: The update goes back to its author with your reason.

commands.prerequisiteRule: Refused while a prerequisite (decision, gate, agreement, approval or evidence) is not satisfied.
commands.approvalAuthority: Within the approved authority matrix the approval rests on your delegated authority; outside it (or without an approved matrix) select the final committee decision that covers it — otherwise the server refuses.

ws.reportedAvg: Average reported progress of active tasks: {value}% (a claim, not verified).

inbox.subtitle: What needs your action across your projects — tasks you own, acceptances, reviews and approvals you may give, committee actions and votes.
inbox.empty: Nothing needs your action right now.
inbox.emptyHint: Items appear here when you own open work or when something awaits your review or approval.

tile.scheduleIncomplete: Whole-plan schedule incomplete: {count} gap(s); no project finish is forecast.
tile.noSlip: No workstream is forecast later than baseline v{version}.

codes.change_control_no_usable_matrix: No approved, verified authority matrix is in force for this project, so no one holds delegated approval authority. Route the change to a committee decision and approve it on that final decision.
codes.change_control_outside_delegated_authori: This approval is outside your delegated authority. Route it to a committee decision of the matching type (escalated to {body} when above the committee's limit) and approve it on that final decision.
This approval is outside your delegated authority. Route it to a committee decision of the matching type and approve it on that final decision.
codes.change_control_amount_unquantified: The cost impact is stated in text only, so it cannot be compared with a limit. Record it as an amount with currency and unit (0 when there is none) in the impact assessment before approval.
codes.change_control_decision_not_final: The selected decision is not final. Only a decision approved within the committee mandate, or approved by the external authority and recorded, can back this approval.
codes.change_control_decision_type_mismatch: The selected decision is of another decision type. Select a decision of the type this approval needs.
codes.change_control_decision_amount_missing: The selected decision carries no amount, so it cannot cover this monetary impact.
codes.change_control_decision_amount_currency: The selected decision is in another currency; no conversion is applied.
codes.change_control_decision_amount_insuffici: The selected decision's amount does not cover this monetary impact.
codes.change_control_decision_already_used: The selected decision already backs another approval: one decision backs one approval.
codes.prerequisite_pending: Blocked by prerequisites not yet satisfied: {count} (decision, gate, agreement, approval or evidence). Some of them may not be visible to you.
codes.prerequisite_pending_noCount: Blocked by prerequisites not yet satisfied (decision, gate, agreement, approval or evidence). Some of them may not be visible to you.
codes.xproj_same_project: Both ends are in this project: use an ordinary dependency instead.
codes.xproj_already_closed: This cross-project dependency is already closed.
codes.xproj_local_item_incomplete: Select both the type and the item of this project, or neither.
codes.change_control_decision_no_subject: The selected decision was not raised for a specific record. Only a decision raised for this change request or baseline version can back its approval: raise a decision paper for it.
codes.change_control_decision_other_subject: The selected decision authorizes another record. Only a decision raised for this change request or baseline version can back its approval.
codes.change_control_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external authority's approval recorded on the selected decision is no longer active and verified (for example it was rejected as defective). The decision no longer backs approvals until the external approval is evidenced again.
codes.change_control_amount_unconfirmed: The cost impact was stated by the requester only. An assessor other than the requester must record or confirm it in the impact assessment before it can decide this approval.
codes.prerequisite_reason_required: Give a reason to remove the prerequisite.
codes.prerequisite_removal_by_blocked_party: This prerequisite still blocks a task or milestone you are accountable for: someone else must remove it (separation of duties).

money.amountInvalid: Enter a decimal amount (at most 4 decimal places), or 0 when there is no cost impact.
money.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. SAR.

approvalDecision.noAccess: You cannot read committee decisions, so you cannot select one. The approval can only rest on your delegated authority; outside it the server refuses it.
approvalDecision.label: Backing governance decision
approvalDecision.hint: Optional within your delegated authority. Needed outside it, or when no approved authority matrix is in force: select the final committee decision of type "{type}" that covers the amount.
approvalDecision.subjectHint: Only decisions raised for this record are offered (the paper names the change request or baseline version it authorizes); a decision whose external approval evidence was rejected no longer counts.
approvalDecision.none: None — approve within my delegated authority
approvalDecision.empty: No final decision of type "{type}" exists yet. A recommendation counts only once the external authority's decision is recorded with verified evidence.
approvalDecision.notFinal: Decisions of this type that are not final yet (not offered): {count}.

xproj.closeEffect: The dependency is closed with your reason and stays on record.
xproj.neededByHint: The date this project needs the other item. At risk = the other item finishes later (schedule-based, no probability).
xproj.outgoing: This project depends on other projects
xproj.incoming: Other projects depend on this project
xproj.emptyOutgoing: No dependencies on other projects that you can see.
xproj.emptyIncoming: No other project that you can read depends on this project.
xproj.emptyHint: Only dependencies whose both ends you can read are shown; nothing is shown about projects you cannot read.
xproj.disclosure: Minimum disclosure: a cross-project dependency is shown only to people who can read both items. Dates and risk are schedule-based.
xproj.createHint: Record that this project needs a task or milestone of another project that you can read.
xproj.noOtherProjects: You can read no other project, so you cannot record a dependency on one.
xproj.otherItemsRestricted: The other project's items could not be loaded with your access.
xproj.localItemHint: Optional: leave empty when the project as a whole depends on it.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites (non-schedule)
prerequisites.hint: Decisions, gates, agreements, approvals or verified evidence this item waits for. They are not schedule (critical path) dependencies.
prerequisites.addHintTask: The task cannot be started while any prerequisite is unsatisfied.
prerequisites.addHintMilestone: The milestone cannot be reported achieved while any prerequisite is unsatisfied.
prerequisites.empty: No prerequisites that you can see.
prerequisites.emptyHint: Prerequisites whose record you cannot see are not listed.
prerequisites.blocksStart: Unsatisfied prerequisites: {count}. The task cannot be started until they are satisfied.
prerequisites.blocksReport: Unsatisfied prerequisites: {count}. The milestone cannot be reported achieved until they are satisfied.

rule.decision: Satisfied by a final decision (approved within the mandate, or approved by the external authority and recorded) — never by a recommendation.
rule.gate: Satisfied when the gate is approved and not flagged for reassessment.
rule.agreement: Satisfied when the agreement is signed or effective.
rule.approval_request: Satisfied when the approval request is approved.
rule.evidence_link: Satisfied when the evidence is active and verified by a second person.

prerequisites.hiddenNote: A start or achievement refusal counts every prerequisite, including any you cannot see.
prerequisites.removeRule: A reason is required. While the prerequisite still blocks, the person accountable for the task or milestone cannot remove it — someone else must (separation of duties).
prerequisites.noTypes: You cannot read any record type that can be a prerequisite.
prerequisites.approvalRequestHint: Approval requests (finance, readiness) have no register on this screen yet and cannot be selected here.
prerequisites.evidenceRecord: Record the evidence is linked to
prerequisites.notCpm: Prerequisites do not move schedule dates; they block starting / reporting achieved until satisfied.
prerequisites.visibility: People who cannot see the prerequisite record do not see it in this list.

rag.not_updated: No accepted update has been recorded.
rag.stale: Last accepted update is {age} days old (stale after {limit}).
rag.unknown: Baseline or forecast finish is missing.
rag.red: Forecast slip of {slip} working days exceeds {limit}.
rag.aggregate: Worst-of {count} item(s): {status}. {red} critical red, {gaps} with data-quality gaps.
rag.override_capped: Manual override to {status} is not applied while {count} red critical item(s) (open blocker / critical milestone) exist — an override cannot conceal them; calculated: {calculated}.

progress.none: No weighted deliverables in scope — progress cannot be calculated.
progress.basis: {num} of {den} weight points accepted across {count} deliverable(s); {excluded} excluded.
progress.deliverable_cancelled: Cancelled — excluded from the denominator, not counted as complete

dq.baselined_undated: {count} baselined item(s) have no planned finish
dq.tasks_no_owner: {count} active task(s) without an accountable owner
dq.project_no_baseline: No approved baseline — variance cannot be measured

example.unsupported_dependency_type: (e.g. a dependency of {node} uses a type the schedule engine does not support yet)
example.unknown_node: (e.g. a dependency references an unknown activity)
example.invalid_date: (e.g. the project start date is invalid)
example.missing_project_start: (e.g. the project has no planned start date)

red.override_not_hiding: (manual override to {status} does not hide the blocker)

assumption.calendar: Durations are in working days on the project calendar ({timezone}, working days {days}, {holidays} holiday(s)).
assumption.fs_only: Only Finish-to-Start dependencies with working-day lag are used.
assumption.no_predecessor_start: Activities without predecessors start at the project start or their start-no-earlier-than date.
assumption.not_probability: Results are schedule-based forecasts derived from the plan, not probabilities.
assumption.delay_applied: Delay applied as +{days} working day(s) to the duration (and any owner forecast finish) of {node}.
assumption.planned_start_snet: Planned start dates act as start-no-earlier-than constraints.
assumption.forecast_extends: Owner-entered forecast finish dates can only extend an activity; actual dates replace plan dates.
assumption.cancelled_ignored: Cancelled activities and their links are ignored.
assumption.draft_one: 1 activity is still Draft (proposed, not yet confirmed into the plan) and included as proposed.
assumption.drafts: {count} activities are still Draft (proposed, not yet confirmed into the plan) and included as proposed.
assumption.driving_network: Scope: the selected activity and every activity that drives it (transitive predecessors) — other activities are not shown.
assumption.deterministic: Deterministic: the same plan, calendar and inputs always give the same result. No probability is estimated.

kanban.title: Kanban board
kanban.hint: One column per task status, over the same tasks as the WBS table and the timeline. Moving a card runs the task's own status command (with its checks, a confirmation and an audit entry): use “Move” on a card, or drag the card onto a column.
kanban.partial: Showing the first {shown} of {total} tasks — narrow the filters to see the rest.
